notes: FR7 is Sony's PTZ cinema camera with E-mount. No T-Number (E-mount only, no PL adapter). Built-in variable ND filter. isPTZF=true: uses 0xE0B6 Pan Position, 0xE0B8 Tilt Position, 0xE041 Zoom Position, 0xE043 Focus Position, SDIO_ControlPTZF (0x9244). Live view uses LiveViewURL (0xD278) — different from stills cameras (not GetObject 0xFFFFC002). Added to PTP3 in v1.3.0 (Jun 2025). Has eframing (0xD090), streaming (video stream properties). Battery=false: FR7 is AC-powered only. Single CFexpress Type A slot.
